internal.title: High Latency Incident in Ad Service Due to CPU Resource Exhaustion
internal.body:
At 10:48 UTC, an alert was triggered for high latency in the ad service. Investigation revealed that the ad service was experiencing very high CPU utilization (98%), causing resource exhaustion and resulting in elevated p95 latency of 1.8 seconds. Secondary latency increases were also observed in the recommendation and product-catalog services but were not the primary cause.

At 11:08 UTC, a mitigation action was approved and executed to disable the flag causing high CPU usage in the ad service. Following this, latency metrics returned to normal levels, confirming recovery.

The incident was resolved by addressing the CPU resource exhaustion in the ad service, restoring normal service performance.

external.title: Latency Issues in Ad Service Resolved
external.body: Between 10:48 and 11:08 UTC, customers experienced increased latency in the ad service. Our team identified the cause as high CPU usage impacting service performance. We have taken corrective actions and the service latency has returned to normal. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
